# ChipInput

A field that takes free text and holds each entry as a removable chip inside it (GAP-222, decision 216): a place's keywords, aliases, e-mail addresses. MultiSelect picks only from its `options`; ChipInput takes whatever the visitor types. The POI editor's Keywords field is a ChipInput.

- **Import:** `import { ChipInput } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; not linked to Figma yet.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-chipinput--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { ChipInput, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function ChipInputExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-96">
        <ChipInput
          label="Keywords"
          placeholder="Add a keyword"
          helperText="Press Enter or type a comma to add one."
          defaultValue={["coffee", "breakfast", "wifi"]}
        />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## ChipInput

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `ChipInputProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children" | "defaultValue" | "onChange">`.

- `value`: `string[]`, optional.

  The entries, controlled.

- `defaultValue`: `string[]`, optional, default `NO_ENTRIES`.

  The entries at first, when the field holds its own.

- `onValueChange`: `(value: string[]) => void`, optional.

  Called with every entry after one is added or removed.

- `inputValue`: `string`, optional.

  The text being typed, controlled.

- `defaultInputValue`: `string`, optional, default `""`.

  The text at first, when the field holds its own.

- `onInputValueChange`: `(value: string) => void`, optional.
- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional.
- `error`: `boolean | string`, optional.
- `helperText`: `string`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `placeholder`: `string`, optional.
- `readOnly`: `boolean`, optional.
- `required`: `boolean`, optional.
- `status`: `InputStatus`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `wrapperClassName`: `string`, optional.
- `inputId`: `string`, optional.

  The `id` of the text input, which the label names.

- `removeLabel`: `(entry: string) => string`, optional, default `` (entry) => `Remove ${entry}` ``.

  Each chip's remove button's name, in the product's language. "Remove {entry}" by default.

- `addedLabel`: `(entry: string) => string`, optional, default `` (entry) => `${entry} added` ``.

  Said politely when an entry is added. "{entry} added" by default.

- `removedLabel`: `(entry: string) => string`, optional, default `` (entry) => `${entry} removed` ``.

  Said politely when an entry is removed. "{entry} removed" by default.

- `duplicateLabel`: `(entry: string) => string`, optional, default `` (entry) => `${entry} is already added` ``.

  Said politely when the typed entry is already in the field, which keeps
  the text and adds nothing. "{entry} is already added" by default.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### InputStatus

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type InputStatus = "default" | "error" | "warning" | "success";
```
